name: choice-lang
description: The first executable model of choice as a language primitive — the #15 milestone body that does not need hardware. The ledger's OPEN row said 'no executable model exists'; this repo is one. A minimal language whose choose(w, U0, U1) nodes compile to controlled-unitary branching on (control, data); the desired world is a marked subspace W; ENGINEERED programs (branches preserving W) keep data-in-W with fidelity exactly 1 over arbitrary program lengths while random programs decay to the dimension ratio; certifying 'the world we want' reopens the epoch-3 ledger toll 1/P at the language layer; the choice register steers but never broadcasts — the no-cloning wall executed as a rephasing-covariance order separation (branch terms order 1, clone terms order 2); and the conservation law that guards stability is exhibited in-model: invariance implies the membership charge is conserved implies stability — the same implication shape as the discrete Noether layer. The checker enforces the model laws; the renderer refuses illegal models. The epoch-5 superstructure question (stability as physics, not compilation) stays OPEN and is not claimed.
